verdict.rationale: Xero's own docs show invoice creation with customizable templates and sending through JAX. They also document online payment through a Pay Now button and Stripe (cards, wallets, ACH), and invoice tracking that alerts you when a customer opens an invoice. However, nothing in the pack documents seeing when a receivable invoice has been paid; the only 'marked as paid' evidence concerns supplier bills, so that part of the story is unevidenced. Missing for 10: documented paid-status tracking or notification for sales invoices, and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond vendor marketing pages and vendor-hosted testimonials.

support.subject: As a founder, I can create and send invoices with online payment options and see when they are viewed and paid

citations.quote: Use customizable invoice templates to create professional invoices fast – add your logo, payment terms, and branding.
JAX is Xero's AI invoicing tool that lets you create, edit, and send invoices using plain-language commands.
Give customers a slick payment process with a Pay Now button on invoices – and encourage prompt payments
Stripe makes it easy to accept payments from debit cards, credit cards, Apple Pay, and Google Pay for online invoices sent from Xero—so you can get paid faster.
Invoice tracking lets you know the moment a customer opens your invoice, so you can follow up at exactly the right time.
